lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately four primary horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, displaying a semi-regular grid distribution between longitudinal ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal spot rows, creating a subtle lattice pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible, exhibiting sharp luminance transitions with bright upper edges and dark shadowed lower boundaries, running parallel to the body axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 12-15 high-intensity circular blobs scattered across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated in the lower two-thirds.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable semi-circular notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin, near its junction with the body.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of significantly smaller, high-frequency white points is visible on the cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit.
